why: Hand chain from the evidence alone: the original instruction reached Hollis Thursday 24 September at 9:40 AM (e5); at latest he signs the next business day, Friday 25 September, and his office ships it that day at 6:00 PM (e6). With no weekend courier service (e7) it reaches Fontaine on Monday 28 September by 10:30 AM (e4, e7); arriving before noon, she signs and ships it the same day (e8, e9). It reaches Landmark Tuesday 29 September by 10:30 AM (e7), inside the 2:00 PM cutoff, and with the instruction the sole outstanding condition (e2, e3), Calloway initiates the wire that same business day (e10) — Tuesday 29 September, before the 30 September 5:00 PM deadline.
